title: Antigravity CLI (agy) as a fourth install target
description:
Alex asked on 2026-11-21 for Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) to be supported in every tool that supports Claude Code and Codex, with everything that differs by harness behind one interface, so the next harness is one more implementation. Program plan, including the five checks every project meets: ~/src/antigravity-project/plan.md. What agy offers: ~/src/tai-personal/docs/antigravity.md.

Here: a fourth adapter beside claude, codex and opencode, installing skills, agents, instructions, hooks, the status line and MCP servers to agy's documented paths. tai-personal's antigravity profile and bundles follow in that repo.
creator: Alexander Terp
